Question: Henna powder with ingredients like (1) para phenylene diamine (2) citric acid (3) herbal amla powder (4) barium peroxide (5) magnesium sulphate is it halal? Answer ID: 2071 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 867/830=D) We are not aware of the details and nature of the ingredients.
